questions.title: What is the first step to solve <math><mrow><msqrt><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn></msqrt><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></math>?
questions.explain: Squaring both sides eliminates the radical.

questions.title: What is an extraneous solution?
choices: An answer that doesn't work in the original equation
questions.explain: Always check your answers to avoid extraneous solutions.

questions.title: How do you undo a cube root?
questions.explain: Raising to the power of 3 undoes a cube root.

questions.title: If <math><mrow><msqrt><mi>x</mi></msqrt><mo>=</mo><mo>-</mo><mn>5</mn></mrow></math>, how many real solutions?
questions.explain: A principal square root cannot be negative.

questions.title: Solve <math><mrow><mn>2</mn><msqrt><mi>x</mi></msqrt><mo>=</mo><mn>10</mn></mrow></math>
questions.explain: Divide by 2 to get <math><mrow><msqrt><mi>x</mi></msqrt><mo>=</mo><mn>5</mn></mrow></math>, then square to get 25.

questions.title: Which operation is the inverse of a square?
questions.explain: Square root is the inverse of squaring.

questions.title: Can you have an extraneous solution with a cube root?
questions.explain: Extraneous solutions typically appear with even-indexed radicals.
